summary: Frontend-only regression verification completed for Case Study 2 visual/theme update and popup metadata update on preview URL.

ui_bugs.issue: CTA still uses blue text color (rgb(5, 52, 102)) instead of strict black/gray monochrome in Case Study 2 popup theme.
Inactive progress dots still render with blue-tinted color (#8ea9c7) from shared modal CSS instead of black/gray-only palette.

action_items: Override Case Study 2 popup CTA color styling to black/gray theme (remove blue text token from shared .case-live-cta styling for this variant).
Override Case Study 2 popup progress dot inactive color to neutral gray/black instead of #8ea9c7.
Re-run frontend regression for Case Study 2 after styling override to confirm no visible blue/cyan remains in popup controls.
critical_code_review_comments: Case modal CSS is heavily shared across themed variants; case-specific theming should avoid hardcoded blue defaults in global selectors (.case-live-cta, .case-progress-nav a).
App.css remains very large (>3000 lines), increasing risk of cross-theme regressions due to shared selectors and cascading overrides.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated on https://micro-moments-8.preview.emergentagent.com. Confirmed pass: Case 2 card accent/border tokens are monochrome, popup sidebar gradient is black/gray, shell is #F3F3F3, logo dot is #111111, Format shows exactly 'Case Study', all 4 PDF frames load, progress nav click/scroll still works, Case 1 and Case 3 popups open/close successfully. Remaining failures are blue-themed shared CSS still visible in Case 2 popup controls (CTA text and inactive progress dots).
rca of the issue: The data-level theme fix in portfolio.js is correct, but popup controls still inherit hardcoded blue defaults from shared App.css modal styles: .case-live-cta { color: #053466 } and .case-progress-nav a { background: #8ea9c7 }. Since these are not fully driven by case-specific CSS variables, Case Study 2 cannot remain strictly monochrome in all popup UI elements.
